name: far-compliant-price-analysis-for-subcontracts-lite
description: Evidence-based bid summaries and price analyses for subcontract actions

interface.shortDescription: Draft subcontract bid and price analyses.
interface.longDescription: Draft BID SUMMARY & PRICE ANALYSIS write-ups for new subcontract awards, option exercises, and modifications, with supported price comparisons, conditional cost-element review, and a final findings table.
interface.defaultPrompt: Draft a BID SUMMARY & PRICE ANALYSIS for this new award, option, or modification. For service or labor-priced work, first ask me for any missing escalation, fee, and labor-load details. Analyze any proposed materials, travel, lower-tier subcontracts, and other direct costs using available price evidence. Include the final findings table.
